### POST `/api/PrintService/CreatePDFfromJobForceTemplateStockIn`

Creates a PDF file from a print job request

### POST `/api/PrintService/CreatePDFfromJobForceTemplate`

Creates a PDF file from a print job request

### POST `/api/PrintService/CreatePDFfromJobForceTemplateWithQuantities`

Creates a PDF file with Stock Item labels from a print job request

### POST `/api/PrintService/PrintTemplatePreview`

Generate a PDF preview of a specific template

### GET `/api/PrintService/GetTemplateList`

Get list of templates for a specific type

| Param | In | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `templateType` | query | `string` | False |

### GET `/api/PrintService/VP_GetPrinters`

Gets list of virtual printers.

### GET `/api/PrintService/GetUsersForPrinterConfig`

Gets a list of users for printer configuration. Only super admin can get the full list. Non super admins can only get their own user

### POST `/api/PrintService/CreateReturnShippingLabelsPDFWithSKUs`

Creates a PDF file of return shipping labels for a single order

### POST `/api/PrintService/CreateReturnShippingLabelsPDF`

Creates a PDF file of return shipping labels for a single order
